specimen.title: Specimen — Sawa
specimen.body: Sawa gives Arabic and Latin text matching proportions and shared vertical metrics, so a mixed line does not change height.

about.title: About Sawa
about.body: Sawa (سوا), meaning "together" in Arabic, is a bilingual type family built on the open-source Amiri typeface and released under the SIL Open Font License.
